transcript: Speaker A (Officer): Ma'am, how much currency are you carrying? Speaker B (Grandmother): I'm carrying 500 pounds in cash, and I have an international debit card for the rest. My grandson has also arranged a travel card for me. Would you like to see the documents? Speaker C (Granddaughter): मैं तो खुद इतनी कॉन्फिडेंटली नहीं बोल पाती इमिग्रेशन पे। दादी, आपने इमिग्रेशन ऑफिसर से ऐसे इंग्लिश में बात की जैसे रोज करती हो। [I can't even speak this confidently at immigration myself. Grandma, you spoke to the immigration officer in English as if you do it every day.] Speaker B (Grandmother): अरे बेटी, बूढ़ी हूँ तो क्या हुआ? दिमाग तो अभी भी चलता है। [Oh daughter, so what if I'm old? My mind still works.] Speaker C (Granddaughter): दादी, मुझे बताइए ये इंग्लिश आपने सीखी कहाँ से इस उम्र में? [Grandma, tell me, where did you learn this English at this age?] Speaker B (Grandmother): बेटी, मेरा पोता दो साल पहले लंदन गया पढ़ाई के लिए... [Daughter, my grandson went to London two years ago for studies... (explains her visa rejection due to lack of English, finding the English Seekho app with a 1-rupee trial, practicing with its AI coach, and successfully getting her visa approved on the second attempt)]. Speaker D (Voiceover): तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
summary: An elderly grandmother surprises her granddaughter by speaking fluent English at airport immigration. She shares how her previous visa was rejected due to her inability to speak English, but she overcame this by practicing daily with the English Seekho app's AI coach. The ad ends with a call to action to download the app.
